name: discord-bot
title: DCS Discord Bot
description: Slash commands for this server from Discord, with buttons and confirmations: /status, /usage, /health, /containers, /stacks, /top, /disk, /updates, /logs, /audit, /schedules, /power, /security, /routes, /dcs for everyone the bot answers; /start, /stop, /restart, /update, /deploy, /backup, /prune, /unban and the container and stack actions for the admins you list. Separate from notifications, which use the Discord webhook in Server Config. Setup guide: docs/DISCORD.md

variables.name: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
variables.label: Discord bot token
variables.description: Discord developer portal → your application → Bot → Reset Token

variables.name: DISCORD_GUILD_ID
variables.label: Discord server ID
variables.description: Right-click your server → Copy Server ID (Developer Mode). Commands register there instantly.

variables.name: DISCORD_ADMIN_IDS
variables.label: Admin user IDs
variables.description: Comma-separated Discord user IDs allowed to start, stop, restart, update, deploy, prune, back up and unban (Developer Mode → right-click a user → Copy User ID)

variables.name: DISCORD_ADMIN_ROLE_IDS
variables.label: Admin role IDs
variables.description: Comma-separated Discord role IDs whose members get the same control commands (right-click a role → Copy Role ID)

variables.name: DISCORD_CHANNEL_IDS
variables.label: Allowed channels
variables.description: Comma-separated channel IDs the bot answers in; leave empty to answer wherever it is invited

variables.name: DCS_BOT_USERNAME
variables.label: DCS user for the bot
variables.description: The DCS account the bot signs in as — created for you as a bot account (day-to-day operations, no access to accounts, secrets, files or DCS itself) if it does not exist yet. Never your own login.

variables.name: DCS_BOT_PASSWORD
variables.label: That user's password
variables.description: Password for that account (press the lock to keep it in the secret store)

variables.name: DCS_API_URL
variables.label: DCS API address
variables.description: As seen from a container on this host

variables.name: DCS_DASHBOARD_URL
variables.label: Dashboard link
variables.description: Optional link on every message, e.g. https://ui.example.com
